{{Quote|I was a mere under-professor the day a Nova scout returning from a just-explored system at the heart of the Yoon Cloud left us a strange, 12-armed glider the likes of which Sanbra had never seen.|Tem Eliss, ''The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life''|<ref name="Anx" />}}
The '''Yoon Cloud''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]]<ref name="Anx" /> situated within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region.<ref name="EAOC" /> Its center contained a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was home to a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Unidentified glider|12-armed glider]]. While returning from the system shortly after its [[Scout/Legends|exploration]], a [[Nova Scout|Nova scout]] carrying a specimen of the species visited the [[University of Sanbra]] and left the glider there for the [[Scientist/Legends|researchers]] to study. [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Tem Eliss]] later mentioned the visit of the scout from the Yoon Cloud in the publication ''[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life]]''.<ref name="Anx" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yoon Cloud was first mentioned in the article ''[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Anx]]'', written by [[Craig Robert Carey]], [[Jason Fry]], and [[Daniel Wallace]] and published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 7|seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine on [[November 1]], [[2001]].<ref name="Anx" /> It was later placed in grid square V-9 by the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
